_comment: Copy to data.json and edit. poolSize: design questions to find. askTop: the most important questions to ask. perRound: questions in one message. autoPickPercent: pick a question with no ask when its top option has more than this percentage. peers: map of repo name to {industry peer product: API docs url} whose public API docs Phase 2 researches. uiParity: map of repo name to the UI path that the repo copies one to one; Phase 2 traces it and each divergence is a user decision.
